source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)

metric.name: E_framework
metric.movement: NO FROZEN-METRIC MOVEMENT; source-generalization obligation moved materially

method_outcomes.B9: PROGRESS: proved a nonproduct high-temperature Ising sparse-defect theorem with collision pressure Pi_2 <= n p [exp(p(exp(beta^2/(1-q))-1))-1], hence n p^2=o(D_n) suffices; product-null calibration gives exact Pi_2=n log(1+p^2 tanh(beta)^2).
method_outcomes.B19: PROGRESS: turned the sparse-defect theorem into local Dobrushin and factor-table certificates returning q, susceptibility bound, factor-intersection degree, eta values, KP margin, replica mismatches, pressure upper bound and degree-loss certificate without 2^n diagonalization.
method_outcomes.B2: REFUTED WEAKENING: expected interface size alone is insufficient. A two-point latent support law can have E|I|=1 while Pi_2=Theta(n); exponential-tail comparison to replica cost is structurally necessary under scalar pressure control.

mathematical_state.dobrushin_sparse_defect_pressure: If q=max_i sum_j tanh|K_ij|<1, W=(1-q)^-1, and S,T are iid Bernoulli(p) defect supports with fixed field amplitude beta, then Pi_2 <= n p [exp(p(exp(beta^2 W)-1))-1] <= n p^2 A exp(pA), A=exp(beta^2 W)-1.
mathematical_state.source_scale_condition: For fixed beta and uniform q<1, n p_n^2=o(D_n) implies Pi_2=o(D_n), even when E|S|=n p_n >> D_n.
mathematical_state.product_null_exact: For Q uniform on {+-1}^n and t=tanh beta, 1+chi2=(1+p_n^2 t^2)^n and Pi_2=n log(1+p_n^2 t^2).
mathematical_state.expectation_counterexample: If S=V with probability epsilon_n and empty otherwise, then E|S cap T|=n epsilon_n^2 but 1+chi2=1+epsilon_n^2((1+t^2)^n-1). For epsilon_n=n^-1/2, E|I|=1 while Pi_2=Theta(n).
mathematical_state.factor_table_local_scales: With a=tanh beta and t_e=tanh K_e, Delta_1=a^2, Delta_2(edge,site)=0, and the first cross-replica spatial bridge is a^2 t_e.
mathematical_state.degree_loss: With previously certified fixed transport tilt s_0, g_n=ceil(Pi_cert/(2s_0)+omega_n)=o(D_n) yields noised low-degree control through D_n-o(D_n).

prior_art_state: Dobrushin comparison/covariance inequalities, high-temperature Ising susceptibility bounds, polymer/cluster expansions, sparse-mixture second-moment calculations, Kato/Toda/QR/spectral flow, Renyi/collision entropy and Davies/Combes-Thomas are prior art. The current result is a source-directed restricted synthesis/certificate; novelty remains UNVERIFIED.
later_negative_stress: Songtao Mao arXiv:2607.20318 remains mandatory and is excluded only through substantive pressure/reference and transport hypotheses, not by naming the rank distinguisher.

next_attack.B11: Dualize Pi_2=log E K over latent-pair laws to obtain entropy-versus-soft-collision variational upper/lower bounds and extend the n p^2 law to dependent support processes through pair-correlation operators.
next_attack.B24: Optimize collision pressure over latent support laws at fixed one-replica marginal or collision entropy; test whether the two-point empty/full law is extremal for first-moment failure and whether iid Bernoulli minimizes pressure.
next_attack.B30: Build the two-color polymer expansion explicitly so every surviving cluster touches both replica colors, then bound path scales and sum a KP tree majorant to recover a p^2 pressure certificate directly from bounded local factor tables.
